Hi Jake — thanks for the details and for sending the docs. Short answers first: we can usually accept a well-documented, reputable 3rd-party assessment older than 12 months on a case-by-case basis, provided certain conditions are met. Below is what we need to validate acceptance.

What we require to accept an older VA/pen-test report for SOC 2 evidence:
- Firm credentials: name of the firm, engagement lead, scope statement, methodology (e.g., blackbox/graybox, authenticated coverage), and a statement of independence. We favor firms that follow industry standards (OWASP, OSSTMM, NIST 800-115) and have client references.
- Report contents: full report + workpapers (not just summary). Workpapers should map findings to timestamps, evidence (screenshots/logs), and remediation tickets.
- Findings maturity: For critical/high findings raised in the report, we need either: (a) proof of remediation plus vendor retest evidence, or (b) a remediation attestation from the customer and a plan for re-test within a defined window (see below). For medium/low findings, a remediation attestation + remediation ticket tracking is usually sufficient.
- Timing policy: Our standard acceptance window is 12 months from date of engagement for un-retested findings. If a report is older than 12 months, we will accept it only when: (a) workpapers show periodic maintenance/patching activity since the report, OR (b) the customer commits to a retest within 90 days and provides a vendor attestation.
- Retest expectations: Full retest preferred for critical/high items. If a full retest can't be completed, we accept targeted retest evidence (retesting only the high/critical findings) with signed test scripts and results.

Operational notes:
- Redaction: You can redact IP addresses and account names from the PDF but do not redact methodology or finding details — we need to see steps to reproduce and remediation verification.
- Sharing: We can accept reports from external firms; if the firm is unknown to us, we'll run a quick vendor check (30–72 hours). We maintain an internal firm acceptability list; PenTest Labs is already on it, which should speed review.
- Evidence upload: Use the secure Drive link, and include a short cover memo summarizing critical findings and remediation status.

If you want, Hannah (cc'd) can coordinate a short intake call with your vendor to confirm the evidence package structure so we can sign off quickly.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
